title: Open cards keep clear of side sheets, the menu and the inbox
text: An open card no longer hides the Chat, Needs you, Agent work or project settings sheets: it narrows to fit beside them. It also never covers the left menu or the inbox's list, even when these are opened or pinned while the card is already open. On a window too narrow for all of them, the sheet lies over the card's right edge and stays fully usable.

more.title: Sheet controls stay usable with an open card
more.text: Settings, Agents and Needs you remain accessible while a card is open. Open a sheet, switch between them, or close it without losing the card conversation.
chapters: Close the sheet and keep the card
